title: Form Instructions
summary: Form instructions explain required data, format, privacy and completion before submission.

MUST.text: State required/optional and non-obvious formats before entry.
State what data is collected, why, and retention or sharing; link to the privacy policy before submission.

SHOULD.text: Use examples matching accepted formats, e.g. "DD/MM/YYYY".
Place instructions adjacent to the field; keep global notes above the form.

AVOID.text: Do not put essential instructions in a distant paragraph.
Do not hide privacy terms behind a generic "Terms" link.

DECIDE.decision: Show pattern plus a valid example
State use, retention and policy link
Use progressive disclosure adjacent to the field

EXAMPLE.good: "Date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), e.g. 14/03/1990. We use this to verify age; see Privacy."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Enter DOB" with no format or privacy note

FAILURE_MODES: Hidden formats cause repeated validation errors.
Privacy surprises reduce trust and completion.
Distant instructions are missed at the point of entry.
Placeholder-only format hints vanish while typing.

sources.title: W3C WCAG 2.2 Understanding Labels or Instructions
